name: Oil Motion
summary: Agent skill that turns an interaction idea into web animation assets — video, sprite atlas, timeline — plus runtime code.
description: A skill for web animation driven by scroll, drag, pointer, touch, device orientation or component state. It locks a concept contract, verifies keyframes, generates continuous motion with AI video, compresses the result into baked video, chroma-key video or alpha sprite atlases according to a budget script, and delivers a compiled timeline, runtime controllers (frame-scrub, segment playback, autonomous playback), interaction code and QA including a static fallback for reduced motion.
contains: scroll, drag, pointer, touch and device-orientation driven animation
keyframe pilot gate before mass generation
delivery formats: baked MP4, chroma-key video, alpha WebP sprite atlas
runtime controllers: frame-scrub, segment playback, autonomous playback
four single-source-of-truth config files (concept contract, brief, timeline, motion budget)
Python + FFmpeg pipeline; API keys kept in the system credential store
